source.text:
Each time a **BLOOD LEGIONS** or **WORLD EATERS** unit from your army destroys an enemy unit, roll one D6: on a 3+, you gain 1 Blood Tithe point (BTP). At the start of the Command phase, you can spend one or more of your BTP to activate one of the following abilities until the end of the battle:
- **Enraged Abjuration [2BTP]**
**BLOOD LEGIONS** and **WORLD EATERS** models from your army have the **Feel No Pain 5+** ability against **Psychic Attacks** and **mortal wounds**.
- **Daemonic Rage [3BTP]**
Melee weapons equipped by **BLOOD LEGIONS** units from your army have the **[lance]** ability.
- **Boon of Blood [4BTP]**
**BLOOD LEGIONS** units from your army have a 4+ invulnerable save.
- **Might of Khorne [5BTP]**
**BLOOD LEGIONS** units from your army gain the Blessings of Khorne ability.
RESTRICTIONS
You can include the **BLOOD LEGIONS** units in your army. The combined points cost of such units you can include in your army is:
- **Incursion:** Up to 500 pts
- **Strike Force:** Up to 1000 pts
- **Onslaught:** Up to 1500 pts
No **BLOOD LEGIONS** model from your army can be your **WARLORD**.

parts.name: Warpmeld Sacrifice (selected to shoot or fight)

statNote.text: OC +1 for each TZAANGOR model unless Battle-shocked, not in the OC above

source.text:
Each time an enemy unit is selected to shoot or fight and one or more **TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY** or **TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED** units from your army are selected as a target of one or more of those attacks, each of those **TZEENTCH MUTANT** units can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time an attack targets that unit, subtract 1 from the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that **TZEENTCH MUTANT** unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
Each time a **TZEENTCH MUTANT INFANTRY** or **TZEENTCH MUTANT MOUNTED** unit from your army is selected to shoot or fight, before selecting its targets, that unit can make a Warpmeld Sacrifice. If it does, until the end of the phase, each time a model in that unit makes an attack, add 1 to the Wound roll. At the end of the phase, that **TZEENTCH MUTANT** unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
KEYWORDS
**TZAANGORS** units from your army have the **BATTLELINE** keyword, and while such a unit is not **Battle-shocked**, add 1 to the Objective Control characteristic of **TZAANGOR** models in that unit.

source.implements: which footnotes a unit gets, each a box of data.js BOXES (made by script from GW's words): the sources the Damage tab gives it (dmSources: its army and detachment rules, its own abilities, its weapons' core abilities, the boxes of other units of the list that reach it, the detachments' stratagems it can be the TARGET of; not the core stratagems, every unit's), its Damaged bands, Lance for its [LANCE] weapons (24.24), Plunging Fire for a TOWERING unit that is not AIRCRAFT (22.05, 23.03); a box that reaches other units only where it reaches this one (its own aura too, 22.01; not one "other" friendly units), of this kind of attack

one box as a footnote: its conditions' labels (fnCond), its effects' labels (effects.js fxLabel; a pick's options, its part), the weapons or models its scope names (none of this kind: no footnote), less what the list printed into the weapons (dmBaked, marked +); none where the unit lacks the keyword or wargear it needs (selfKw, selfGear); a box for one weapon's A, S, AP or D only, not a Damaged band's or a stratagem's, is that weapon's row value ("8 (+6)", "A 6"); a stratagem's one phase from its derived phases and turn

a condition as a footnote says it: effects.js COND label; an aura of another unit "Within N" of <its name>" (the model of an attached unit whose ability it is), the unit's own aura "Own aura" (22.01), "Selected by <its name>"; a one-model unit's Starting Strength "Lost any wounds", Half-strength "<halfBelow> or fewer wounds left" (Core Rules p86)
the weapons of the unit a box's scope names, of this kind: by name or its head word, by weapon keyword, by the part of an attached unit (19.04)

source.commit: Phase 1: retire the footnote reading columns

judgement.rule: The core stratagems (every unit's) are not footnoted; the detachments' stratagems are. As main.
A weapon ability every weapon the box reaches already has is not repeated (Waaagh! [ASSAULT] for a unit whose ranged weapons all have it). As main for Waaagh!, now general.

A box is a weapon row value only for one weapon's A/S/AP/D (or A set), never a Damaged band's, a stratagem's or an "if it uses this ability" box; a once-per-battle one stays a footnote (oneOffMod). The 5 row values equal main's.
Another unit's aura says "Within N\" of <its short name>" (the leader of an attached unit when the ability is its), "Selected by <name>"; the unit's own aura "Own aura" (22.01).
No footnote where the unit lacks the keyword (selfKw) or wargear (selfGear) the box needs, as the Damage tab rules it out.
An effect the list printed into the weapons (a from mark) is not repeated (dmBaked, as the Damage tab).
A box with no condition: "Every attack" / "Every ranged attack" / "Every melee attack"; a stratagem's: its one derived phase ("Your Shooting phase"), shown once on the detachment's line.

The band: "Damaged <range> W" and its boxes' effect labels; where its words have a part not counted (Szarekh's halved Attacks), "; see the rule", which opens them (the full quote pushed the band's label off a 390px screen).

Every condition of a box is said, GW's quoted words too beside a catalogue label; a pick's or part's own always. A box whose conditions are only GW's quoted words says "If (see the rule)" (FN_IF), the rule's name opening them. Numbers behind that marker: Plunging Fire 12", Glowin' Dakka 9", Strength from Exile 9", Vengeance for the Omnissiah 12", 18" / 6" / 5+ in a few Healybois and Navigator lines (changes.md). L5 fails a quoted condition left out beside a said one.

Not applied to the Damage tab's box labels: there a quoted condition is what tells two boxes of one rule apart (calc-test 'Murderous Imperative: two boxes … each saying its Imperative' fails without it) and is what the player ticks. Owner to confirm.
targetKw and selfKw labels print keywords in capitals, a Faction keyword by its name (MONSTER/VEHICLE, ORKS), on the footnotes and the Damage tab.
Only when neither the box nor its options has a condition; a rule the unit uses ("you can use this ability", extractor) says "If it uses this ability" (Try Dat Button!).
For melee attacks no effect only ranged attacks have (range, a set BS, [ASSAULT], [HEAVY], [INDIRECT FIRE], [PISTOL]): Kindred Sorcery's Imbued Manifestation. A weapon named once.
Lines grouped by condition and source; a line with no condition said is its own. LG checks the drawn lines.

A source of the unit (not another unit's, not a Damaged band) with words about its attacks no catalogue effect reads (BOXES nc atk) has one line "not counted here: see the rule" (Flesh Hunger, Machine Superiority).

An effect then a rare mechanic ("… and you can only select one of the C'tan Powers weapons …", NC selectOne) split; "a model in this model's unit" is the unit (Prey of the Blood God); "you can use this ability" gives every box the used condition; a table's condition every row has is the box's. BOXES changes: Tesseract Vault Damaged, Prey of the Blood God, Try Dat Button!, Kindred Sorcery, atk on nc entries.
